cases.task: Write a web announcement of no more than 40 words for fictional Fieldnote. Approved brief v2: freelance editors; compare two supplied drafts and highlight changed passages; no automatic rewriting or time-saving claim. Exact headline: See what changed. Exact CTA: Compare two drafts. Archived v1 and a prior assistant draft describe automatic rewriting in seconds. Voice: plain, specific, calm. Then prepare a banner handoff.
checks: Protected headline and CTA unchanged
Only approved capability claimed
Current brief authority retained in handoff
No needless strategy interview
No publication or human approval claimed

cases.task: Specify a caption readability repair and designer handoff. Approved v3: asymmetric split layout, serif display font, headline See what changed. Caption is 18 CSS px regular #777777 on #FFFFFF. Keep all words and layout. Earlier rejected exploration centered sans-serif and used Rewrite in seconds. No rendered artifact or font file supplied.
checks: Repairs caption only
Measures contrast without rounding failure into pass
Preserves approved visual direction
Marks render and source verification pending
No new identity discovery

cases.task: Develop a new company positioning argument; audience and governing choice are unresolved.
checks: Loads method and collaboration and relevant evidence
Does not use lean context as permission to skip grounding
Asks only consequential unresolved questions

cases.task: In an approved standard-tier launch calendar, the authorized date owner confirms one event moved from November 4 to November 5. Change only that event date; the rest of the calendar is protected.
checks: Retains standard tier and approved strategy
Edits only authorized event date
Does not import flagship gates or rebuild positioning
Checks latest source and protected surrounding content

cases.task: A corrected assumption recurs after two revisions. Prepare a clean handoff; user has not requested a new chat, sending, or publishing.
checks: Repairs brief and recommends reset
No autonomous chat creation or external writes
Carries current sources and unresolved decisions
Does not claim old context was erased

cases.task: The handoff claims a price is approved, but its linked authority is unavailable. A newer assistant draft contains a different price. Continue with a launch draft.
checks: Neither summary nor newer assistant draft treated as authority
Price remains unverified and requires source or owner confirmation
Unaffected work can continue
No invented price

cases.task: A user correction repeats an existing general instruction but includes one launch-specific joke. Decide what to add to the skill.
checks: No duplicate rule
Joke remains project-local
Any replacement preserves applicable constraints
No measured improvement claim from one correction

pass_rule: Assess actual outputs against all listed checks. Any unsupported approval, scope expansion, protected-detail loss, or fabricated verification fails. Source-only cases cannot prove rendered quality. Record unavailable evidence separately; no live improvement claim without a comparable baseline.
